g.text: Both T holes are the tip (Neutrik: one tip circuit, no switch). No plug detection

g.desc: Both T holes are the tip (Neutrik: one tip circuit, no switch). No plug detection

g.text: 9 V Boss supply, centre pin GND, SS34, TVS, 5 V buck, 5VA rail

g.desc: 9 V Boss supply, centre pin GND, SS34, TVS, 5 V buck, 5VA rail

g.text: 14 pots to U101 (C14, C15 on GND), 3 encoders, 8 toggles, OLED header

g.desc: 14 pots to U101 (C14, C15 on GND), 3 encoders, 8 toggles, OLED header

g.text: Pole A COM BUF_IN, NC PRE_OUT, NO DAC_ATT. Pole B COM GND, NO FX_ON_SENSE (low = effect on). Coil on = effect on

g.desc: Pole A COM BUF_IN, NC PRE_OUT, NO DAC_ATT. Pole B COM GND, NO FX_ON_SENSE (low = effect on). Coil on = effect on

g.text: 470R / 2.2nF filter, 10uF, DAC_ATT = 0.6 x DAC about VREF

g.desc: 470R / 2.2nF filter, 10uF, DAC_ATT = 0.6 x DAC about VREF

g.text: K102 closes OUT_AC to OUT_TIP when MUTE_N is high, else OUT_TIP is grounded

g.desc: K102 closes OUT_AC to OUT_TIP when MUTE_N is high, else OUT_TIP is grounded

g.text: VREF: 5VA divided 10k/10k, 10 uF, follower U106A, 22R into VREF with 10 uF. U106B drives block 6

g.desc: VREF: 5VA divided 10k/10k, 10 uF, follower U106A, 22R into VREF with 10 uF. U106B drives block 6

g.text: Input Gain pot is the A4 feedback resistor, wiper tied to end 3. G = 1 + Rpot/330

g.desc: Input Gain pot is the A4 feedback resistor, wiper tied to end 3. G = 1 + Rpot/330

g.text: Bypass toggle. Common to the coil, one throw to 5V

g.desc: Bypass toggle. Common to the coil, one throw to 5V

g.text: Chain 20-50 dB XLR / -5.6 to +24.3 dB TRS; DC gain 1 (AC-coupled legs)

g.desc: Chain 20-50 dB XLR / -5.6 to +24.3 dB TRS; DC gain 1 (AC-coupled legs)

g.text: Stage 1 INA 20.05 dB (U104, U105A). Stage 2 0-29.9 dB on Input Gain pot (U105B)

g.desc: Stage 1 INA 20.05 dB (U104, U105A). Stage 2 0-29.9 dB on Input Gain pot (U105B)

g.text: XLR leg 47R, BAT54S clamp, 100pF, 100k to GND, 47uF + IN_x. TRS leg 10uF + LINE_x, 22k pad, 100k to GND. 1.2k bias to VREF

g.desc: XLR leg 47R, BAT54S clamp, 100pF, 100k to GND, 47uF + IN_x. TRS leg 10uF + LINE_x, 22k pad, 100k to GND. 1.2k bias to VREF

g.text: RG = R109 1k + C158 22uF bipolar in series, DC gain 1. Gain 1 + 2 x 4.53k / 1k = 10.06

g.desc: RG = R109 1k + C158 22uF bipolar in series, DC gain 1. Gain 1 + 2 x 4.53k / 1k = 10.06
